summary: (Because AWS support admitted this is a bug of Fargate, I'm adding this issue for visibility.) Sometimes a container status doesn't become STOPPED while the actual process (PID 1) in the container exited. They say it is because the Fargate agent failed to propagate the change of task status to some internal system. When this problem happens, users must terminate the task manually to remove it. Reproduces in ECS Fargate 1.4.0.
title: [Fargate] [BUG]: Container status does not properly reflect the actual status
